items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: The original Ma Rainey from Columbus, Georgia.

ctx.x: The original Ma Rainey from Columbus, Georgia. Well, there was a Ma Rainey on the Rabbit Show, I remember. But it wasn't the original Ma Rainey that I remember. I remember there's a lady in Memphis, Tennessee, calls herself Ma Rainey.
